jsBridge: Tracking elapsed time with `startTime` + `elapsedBeforePause` survives pausing when the scene goes inactive. It's the same pattern as a JS stopwatch storing `Date.now()` deltas rather than counting `setInterval` ticks.

compass.q: A JS stopwatch counting `setInterval` ticks drifts. Why does storing timestamps and computing deltas fix it?
The user changes the device clock mid-game: does `Date()` jump? What clock is immune (`ContinuousClock`)?
`Text(date, style: .timer)` vs a `TimelineView` vs your own timer: which updates the UI without your code running every second?
Where should pausing be triggered: `scenePhase` changes, `onDisappear`, or both?
